idea-plugin.name: Artifexa
idea-plugin.description:
Artifexa — AI-Powered Visual Code-Change Review

Artifexa analyses every commit on a Git feature branch since its divergence from the base branch, constructs a semantic component graph of all touched code, and applies an AI review layer that evaluates architectural quality, best-practice adherence, and task-completion progress against a developer-supplied task description.

  • Automatic branch-point (merge-base) detection
  • PSI-based component graph with call / inheritance / injection edges
  • Layer-violation detection (Controller → Service → Repository → Domain)
  • Interactive, pan/zoom graph in a Tool Window
  • AI review: architecture, best-practices, task-completion scoring
  • Source code never leaves your machine in raw form — only structured summaries
